title: Quietly Energizing Chinese Yogurt Buddha Jumps Over Wall
description: A refreshing and energizing Chinese dessert featuring yogurt, candy, and herbal ingredients, served in a molcajete vessel and shaped like Buddha Jumps Over Wall.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the crushed rock candy and 1 cup of water, and heat over low heat, stirring until the candy dissolves.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the ground dried ginger and dried green tea leaves, letting it steep for 10 minutes.
Strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a large bowl, discarding the solids.
Add the plain yogurt, honey, and dried jasmine flowers to the bowl, and stir until well combined.
Fold in the canned lychee fruit.
Spoon the mixture into a molcajete vessel.
Shape the mixture into a Buddha Jumps Over Wall shape.
Refrigerate the dessert for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Serve chilled and garnished with additional dried jasmine flowers if desired.
